flags.why: This denotes distance maintained in social interaction, rather than the disease-prevention practice of social distancing ([source](https://www.logspath.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/KY-NANG-GIAO-TIEP-TRONG-KINH-DOANH-TAP-1-TS.-NGUYEN-VAN-HUNG.pdf)).

The gloss confuses social distance with social distancing, which is giãn cách xã hội ([source](https://www2.gnb.ca/content/dam/gnb/Departments/ed/pdf/promo/learning_at_home/vietnamese/SocialDistancingVietnamese.pdf)).
Everyday colloquial uses such as Thế thì khoẻ rồi express relief from trouble or effort rather than physical health or strength.
flags.fix: Add a sense tagged colloquial: free from trouble or effort; at ease.
